title: Persistent Borrelia burgdorferi Peptidoglycan in Postinfectious Lyme Arthritis: Innate Immune Sensing and Translational Implications.
snippet: Lyme arthritis (LA) is the late articular manifestation ofinfection. It is ordinarily treated successfully with appropriate antibiotic therapy. In a subset of patients, however, synovitis persists for months to years after treatment, despite presumed eradication of the spirochete.
